name: ThemeLensReviews
job: Show a set of reviews with theme chips (service, price, speed, quality); choosing a chip highlights the matching sentences across all reviews and fades the rest
visitor_action: tap a chip; tap again to clear; keyboard focus on chips (arrow keys move between chips)
mobile: chips scroll sideways, reviews stack in one column; two-column spread from 720px container width
motion: rack focus on theme change: the lead matched sentence rises in as a 40-64px marked hero pull-quote, the list briefly defocuses, matching reviews glide to the top with a spring FLIP (staggered, interruptible), non-matching reviews recede (blur, fade, scale down) and sharpen on hover or keyboard focus, then the ultramarine marker is drawn line by line in two ink passes (light base first, deeper streaked pass after) across matched sentences one by one, and the count ticks in (reduced-motion: static marker, faded non-matches without blur or movement)
art_direction: Signal blue, depth of field (light): crisp white ground, oversized near-black grotesk heading, editorial two-column review spread on hairlines, textured ultramarine marker strokes (streaked ink, ragged chisel edges) on matched sentences, non-matching reviews out of focus; flat hairline chips with solid ultramarine active chip

checks.craft: 3 (self, advisory; borderline on bar items 1 and 7)
